v: GREAT ki just short... VERY NICE మాత్రం pakka 😄 Nag nails it, Karthi is super lovable, emotion + entertainment balance works. Still, somewhere aa small ‘something missing’ feeling undi.
e: Oopiri balances its emotional core with enough entertainment to avoid becoming a much heavier experience. Nagarjuna nails the role, Karthi’s innocent expressions are a major asset and I loved Prakash Raj’s character. I had no issue with the remake being faithful; the team deserves credit for bringing a good French story naturally to Telugu audiences.
body:
#OOPIRI …. fells short of being a great movie and ends up in very nice category!!! Vamsi ensured to have enough entertainment (not sure if the original had same level of entertainment) else would have ended being a sequal to #Guzaarish

performance wise Nag has nailed it and Karthi’s innocent expressions were an asset to the storyline….storywise loved the char of Prakash Raj

for all those intellectuals talking about scene 2 scene copy paste from Original…..WHO CARE’s!!!! there were many previous instances of copy paste messing up things….one should appreciate team’s effort to bring a good french story to telugu audience ( not all audiences are blessed with special powers of you to watch and understand French/Spanish/Roman/Korean/English films…..we feel comfortable to watch movie in native language )

Finally once I walked out of theater…..I have the feeling of watching a very nice movie but with a feel of something missing???
